description: Sanitized local-first media workflow from controlled input discovery through separate review and export approval.

stages.name: Discover controlled inputs
stages.description: Validate relative paths under a host-controlled root without modifying source media.

required_inputs.description: Portable relative paths to authorized media

artifacts.description: Validated media references without embedded media bytes

stages.name: Inspect controlled media
stages.description: Collect bounded technical evidence without modifying originals.

stages.name: Propose storyboard and timeline
stages.description: Produce a bounded candidate that cannot approve or render itself.

stages.name: Review candidate
stages.description: A human accepts, rejects, or revises the proposal without exporting media.

artifacts.description: Human decision referencing an exact candidate revision

stages.name: Finalize approved output
stages.description: The private application validates approval and writes a non-overwriting local artifact.

artifacts.description: Locally validated output with audit metadata

approval_gates.name: Approve export
approval_gates.description: Confirm the exact reviewed revision before any final media output is written.

safety.network_policy: The public contract performs no provider call. Private adapters must declare and explicitly enable any network use.

side_effects.description: Writes a new validated output without overwriting source media or an existing formal output.

idempotency.description: An unchanged input set and candidate revision do not repeat a completed finalization.
